nodes.description: Public token name string set to 'Alien' in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set to 'ALIEN' in the constructor.
Public token decimals value set to 10 in the constructor.
Total token supply storage variable assigned in the constructor and read in totalSupply().
Mapping of address balances; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom, read by balanceOf and totalSupply indirectly.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) written by approve and transferFrom and read by allowance.
SafeMath safeAdd(uint a, uint b) performing an unchecked addition with a require on the result.
SafeMath safeSub(uint a, uint b) reverting when b > a, otherwise performing subtraction.
SafeMath safeMul(uint a, uint b) performing an unchecked multiplication validated after the fact.
SafeMath safeDiv(uint a, uint b) requiring b > 0 and then dividing.
Alien constructor initializing metadata, minting the whole supply to msg.sender and emitting Transfer.
Public view returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked raw subtraction.
Public view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Public function writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
Public function debiting balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and crediting the recipient via safeAdd.
Public function moving tokens between accounts and decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
Untrusted caller address used as token owner/minter in the constructor and in approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Raw unchecked subtraction `_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]` inside totalSupply() compiled with solc 0.5.0.
Addition `c = a + b` inside safeAdd followed only by a post-hoc require check.
Subtraction `c = a - b` inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication `c = a * b` inside safeMul guarded only by a post-hoc division check.
Division `c = a / b` inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
First parameter `a` of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second parameter `b` of SafeMath.safeAdd.
First parameter `a` of SafeMath.safeSub.
Second parameter `b` of SafeMath.safeSub.
First parameter `a` of SafeMath.safeMul.
Second parameter `b` of SafeMath.safeMul.
First parameter `a` of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Second parameter `b` of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Parameter `spender` of approve, used as the key of the allowed mapping.
Parameter `tokens` of approve, written as the allowance value.
Parameter `to` of transfer, the credited recipient address.
Parameter `tokens` of transfer, the amount passed to safeSub and safeAdd.
Parameter `from` of transferFrom, the debited source address.
Parameter `to` of transferFrom, the credited destination address.
Parameter `tokens` of transferFrom, the amount deducted from balance and allowance.
Parameter `tokenOwner` of balanceOf used as the balances mapping key.
Parameter `tokenOwner` of allowance used as the outer allowed mapping key.
Parameter `spender` of allowance used as the inner allowed mapping key.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key that receives the entire initial supply in balances inside the constructor.
The untrusted deploying address drives execution of the constructor and becomes the initial token holder.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the untrusted caller controls the owner slot of the allowance mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], making the untrusted caller the source of funds.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender when reducing allowed[from][msg.sender].
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable as the base of its return expression.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the raw unchecked subtraction inside totalSupply().
The unchecked subtraction is executed on every call to totalSupply(), enabling underflow/overflow behaviour.
safeAdd always executes the raw addition c = a + b before validating the result.
safeSub executes the raw subtraction c = a - b guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul executes the raw multiplication c = a * b before the overflow check.
safeDiv executes the raw division c = a / b after requiring b > 0.
Parameter a is an operand of the unchecked addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the unchecked addition in safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter a is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter a is the numerator of the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the denominator of the division in safeDiv.
The spender parameter becomes the inner key of the allowed mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter is written as the allowance value for msg.sender in approve.
The to parameter is used as the credited key in the balances mapping during transfer.
The tokens parameter is deducted from balances[msg.sender] through the unchecked safeSub subtraction.
The from parameter is the debited key in the balances mapping during transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited key in the balances mapping during transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is subtracted from both balance and allowance via the unchecked safeSub subtraction.
transfer internally calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer internally calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom internally calls SafeMath.safeSub for balance and allowance deduction.
transferFrom internally calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approve writes the new allowance into the allowed mapping state variable.
balanceOf reads its result directly from the balances mapping.
allowance reads its result directly from the allowed mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key consumed by balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer lookup key consumed by allowance.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer level of the allowed mapping.
The spender parameter is the inner lookup key consumed by allowance.
The spender parameter indexes the inner level of the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd only feeds the unchecked addition, so it is folded into that unsafe operation node.
Parameter b of safeAdd only feeds the unchecked addition, so it is folded into that unsafe operation node.
Parameter a of safeSub is the minuend of the guarded subtraction and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter b of safeSub is the subtrahend of the guarded subtraction and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter a of safeMul only feeds the unchecked multiplication and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter b of safeMul only feeds the unchecked multiplication and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter a of safeDiv is the numerator of the guarded division and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter b of safeDiv is the denominator of the guarded division and merges into that unsafe operation.
The spender argument is only meaningful inside approve where it indexes the allowed mapping.
The tokens argument is only written to the allowance mapping inside approve.
The to argument is only used by transfer to credit the recipient balance.
The tokens argument is only used by transfer when calling safeSub and safeAdd.
The from argument is only used by transferFrom to select the debited balance slot.
The to argument is only used by transferFrom to credit the recipient balance.
The tokens argument is only used by transferFrom when deducting balance and allowance.
The tokenOwner argument is exclusively used as the balances lookup key inside balanceOf.
The tokenOwner argument is exclusively used as the outer allowed lookup key inside allowance.
The spender argument is exclusively used as the inner allowed lookup key inside allowance.
